boundary: This live ledger is derived from the immutable handoff baseline. Task and lens dispositions default to open, and only validated explicit progress changes them; no implementation, review, or closure is inferred.

phases.title: Freeze current head, inventory every file, and establish truthful baseline
Reconcile documentation, claims, governance ledgers, and repository identity
Stabilize canonical run-log, replay, bridge, intervention, and artifact semantics
Complete EC1 capture, intervention, replay, and infrastructure benchmarking
Freeze M0 population, estimands, data rights, holdout, contamination, and analysis governance
Complete H1 common preflight and Protocol A paired frozen-snapshot sensitivity
Implement H1 Protocol B randomized closed-loop effect modification
Complete H2 prospective censoring-aware failure prediction
Complete H4 representational availability versus causal policy use
Keep H3 PID conditional, gated, leakage-safe, and scientifically interpretable
Complete comparator frontier, uncertainty, power, multiplicity, and blind benchmarking
Harden SAFE and future real-VLA capture, tensor provenance, hooks, and data lineage
Migrate NCP/Engram observation and preserve optional ecosystem composition
Security, privacy, resource, parser, concurrency, and supply-chain hardening
Packaging, CI, reproducibility, usability, and release engineering
Independent verification, thesis-board evidence, local convergence, and final release

status_contract.closure_rule: Terminal states are reserved for a successor schema that binds every typed task obligation to authenticated evidence; schema 0.1 records only open, in-progress, blocked, and wave-rework state

baseline_requirements.completion_rule: Do not close on compilation, a single test, or prose. Close only when the normative requirement, all applicable evidence tiers, twenty-lens review, migration, docs, and independent review pass. Otherwise remove/narrow the claim or leave the task OPEN.
baseline_requirements.head_mismatch_rule: STOP before editing if HEAD, submodule identity, generated inputs, or relevant upstream release identity changed; produce a diff and re-open affected requirements.
mandatory_adversarial_questions: What invalid or misleading state can still be represented through JSON, Rust API, Python API, CLI, fixture, migration, or manual file edit?
What happens at empty, minimum, maximum, duplicate, stale, reordered, replayed, future-dated, censored, partially initialized, and shutdown boundaries?
Can a failed prerequisite, absent optional component, missing label, abstention, parse error, timeout, or exhausted capacity become a positive result?
Can tuning, visualization, derived artifacts, model selection, or off-repository access leak holdout information?
Can a green synthetic or in-process test pass while the real scientific, security, or deployment claim is false?
Could a reviewer reasonably confuse this output with evidence for H1, H2, H3, H4, EC1, causal use, safety, or PID validity?
baseline_requirements.phase_title: Freeze current head, inventory every file, and establish truthful baseline
preconditions: Exact clean Prisoma commit and pid-rs submodule identity are recorded.
Every relevant tracked file and generated source is listed in the assignment.
Current behavior and public claim tier are documented before code changes.
Ambiguities and counterexamples are written before selecting semantics.
procedure: Read every in-scope file line by line and update FILE_REVIEW_LEDGER.csv with blob and SHA-256 identities.
Map each input, state, time, identity, output, failure, resource limit, assumption, and public statement.
Write normative SHALL/SHALL NOT requirements with stable identifiers.
Construct simple, odd, boundary, malformed, stale, replayed, missing, shifted, and adversarial counterexamples.
Implement the smallest coherent change; delete or quarantine contradictory fallback and historical paths.
Add unit, boundary, negative, property/metamorphic, fuzz, state-machine, statistical, and integration tests appropriate to the claim.
Generate evidence tied to exact code, tools, configuration, seeds, hardware, datasets, models, splits, and raw outputs.
Update schemas, migration, docs, claim registry, capability matrix, and exact dependency identities.
Run the local subsystem gate, complete wave gate, and every affected cross-repository conformance check.
Obtain independent review; record residual assumptions and claim impact.
required_evidence: complete commands, logs, and exit statuses
raw and summarized metrics with uncertainty where relevant
positive and negative fixtures or vectors
required_tests: property, metamorphic, or model-based case where applicable
full regression and documentation example gate

baseline_requirement.name: Claims and scope
baseline_requirement.question: Could a reasonable reader infer a stronger scientific, engineering, security, or deployment claim than the retained evidence supports?

baseline_requirement.name: First-principles semantics
baseline_requirement.question: Are every estimand, event, intervention, diagnostic, outcome, state, transition, and refusal defined operationally rather than by suggestive names?

baseline_requirement.name: Causal identification
baseline_requirement.question: Are treatment assignment, pre-treatment timing, consistency, positivity, interference, confounding, censoring, and estimand identification assumptions explicit and defensible?

baseline_requirement.name: Statistics and uncertainty
baseline_requirement.question: Are sampling units, dependence, multiplicity, calibration, confidence intervals, missingness, power, stopping, and sensitivity analyses correct?

baseline_requirement.name: PID and information theory
baseline_requirement.question: Are population, measure, estimator, and application gates separate; are atoms, units, preprocessing, support, and refusal semantics scientifically valid?

baseline_requirement.name: Type and state integrity
baseline_requirement.question: Can invalid study, split, episode, run-log, capture, intervention, model, or protocol states be represented or silently promoted?

baseline_requirement.name: Time, ordering, and replay
baseline_requirement.question: Are source time, receipt time, landmark time, treatment time, outcome time, censoring time, epoch, sequence, restart, and replay semantics unambiguous?

baseline_requirement.name: Identity and provenance
baseline_requirement.question: Can every result be traced to exact code, dependency, model, checkpoint, hook, tensor, dataset, split, transform, seed, configuration, and source artifact?

baseline_requirement.name: Data rights, privacy, and ethics
baseline_requirement.question: Are licenses, consent, personal data, human-subject issues, dataset rights, redaction, retention, and redistribution addressed before capture or release?

baseline_requirement.name: Security and hostile inputs
baseline_requirement.question: Can malformed JSON/NPZ/run logs, paths, bridges, NCP frames, model artifacts, or authenticated malicious peers corrupt state, escape confinement, or cause unsafe behavior?

baseline_requirement.name: Resource bounds and denial of service
baseline_requirement.question: Are bytes, rows, dimensions, events, episodes, artifacts, queues, requests, retries, logs, memory, CPU, disk, and session lifetime bounded before expensive work?

lenses.name: Resource bounds and denial of service

baseline_requirement.name: Concurrency, lifecycle, and crash consistency
baseline_requirement.question: Are append/ack ordering, partial writes, fsync scope, cancellation, shutdown, retries, restart, poisoned state, and cross-file transactions specified and tested?

baseline_requirement.name: Determinism and reproducibility
baseline_requirement.question: Can a clean party reproduce builds, generated governance files, fixtures, randomization, simulations, metrics, reports, and package bytes?

baseline_requirement.name: API, schema, and SemVer
baseline_requirement.question: Is the stable surface minimal and versioned; are unknown fields, migration, panic, allocation, feature, and compatibility rules explicit?

baseline_requirement.name: Baselines and falsification
baseline_requirement.question: Are strong non-PID comparators, negative controls, placebo checks, shuffled controls, odd/quirky cases, and simpler explanations tested fairly?

baseline_requirement.name: Holdout and contamination control
baseline_requirement.question: Are tuning and evaluation separated; is access auditable; are transforms fitted train-only; are task/model/family leakage and off-repo access considered?

baseline_requirement.name: Verification and evidence quality
baseline_requirement.question: Does each claim have the right evidence tier: unit/property/model, independent oracle, formal proof, blind holdout, external benchmark, or real study?

baseline_requirement.name: Ecosystem composition
baseline_requirement.question: Are pid-rs, NCP, Engram, Crebain, Galadriel, Haldir, SAFE, Rerun, ROS, and external tools integrated without hidden coupling or authority confusion?

baseline_requirement.name: Human factors and thesis defensibility
baseline_requirement.question: Can a reviewer understand the theory, assumptions, negative results, status, commands, evidence, and limits without being a Rust expert?

baseline_requirement.name: Counterfactual misuse and future maintenance
baseline_requirement.question: How could a rushed researcher, malicious source, overconfident paper, or future maintainer misuse a convenience path or reinterpret a result?

baseline_requirement.name: Claims and scope
baseline_requirement.question: Could a reasonable reader infer a stronger scientific, engineering, security, or deployment claim than the retained evidence supports?

baseline_requirement.name: First-principles semantics
baseline_requirement.question: Are every estimand, event, intervention, diagnostic, outcome, state, transition, and refusal defined operationally rather than by suggestive names?

baseline_requirement.name: Causal identification
baseline_requirement.question: Are treatment assignment, pre-treatment timing, consistency, positivity, interference, confounding, censoring, and estimand identification assumptions explicit and defensible?

baseline_requirement.name: Statistics and uncertainty
baseline_requirement.question: Are sampling units, dependence, multiplicity, calibration, confidence intervals, missingness, power, stopping, and sensitivity analyses correct?

baseline_requirement.name: PID and information theory
baseline_requirement.question: Are population, measure, estimator, and application gates separate; are atoms, units, preprocessing, support, and refusal semantics scientifically valid?

baseline_requirement.name: Type and state integrity
baseline_requirement.question: Can invalid study, split, episode, run-log, capture, intervention, model, or protocol states be represented or silently promoted?

baseline_requirement.name: Time, ordering, and replay
baseline_requirement.question: Are source time, receipt time, landmark time, treatment time, outcome time, censoring time, epoch, sequence, restart, and replay semantics unambiguous?

baseline_requirement.name: Identity and provenance
baseline_requirement.question: Can every result be traced to exact code, dependency, model, checkpoint, hook, tensor, dataset, split, transform, seed, configuration, and source artifact?

baseline_requirement.name: Data rights, privacy, and ethics
baseline_requirement.question: Are licenses, consent, personal data, human-subject issues, dataset rights, redaction, retention, and redistribution addressed before capture or release?

baseline_requirement.name: Security and hostile inputs
baseline_requirement.question: Can malformed JSON/NPZ/run logs, paths, bridges, NCP frames, model artifacts, or authenticated malicious peers corrupt state, escape confinement, or cause unsafe behavior?

baseline_requirement.name: Resource bounds and denial of service
baseline_requirement.question: Are bytes, rows, dimensions, events, episodes, artifacts, queues, requests, retries, logs, memory, CPU, disk, and session lifetime bounded before expensive work?

lenses.name: Resource bounds and denial of service

baseline_requirement.name: Concurrency, lifecycle, and crash consistency
baseline_requirement.question: Are append/ack ordering, partial writes, fsync scope, cancellation, shutdown, retries, restart, poisoned state, and cross-file transactions specified and tested?

baseline_requirement.name: Determinism and reproducibility
baseline_requirement.question: Can a clean party reproduce builds, generated governance files, fixtures, randomization, simulations, metrics, reports, and package bytes?

baseline_requirement.name: API, schema, and SemVer
baseline_requirement.question: Is the stable surface minimal and versioned; are unknown fields, migration, panic, allocation, feature, and compatibility rules explicit?

baseline_requirement.name: Baselines and falsification
baseline_requirement.question: Are strong non-PID comparators, negative controls, placebo checks, shuffled controls, odd/quirky cases, and simpler explanations tested fairly?

baseline_requirement.name: Holdout and contamination control
baseline_requirement.question: Are tuning and evaluation separated; is access auditable; are transforms fitted train-only; are task/model/family leakage and off-repo access considered?

baseline_requirement.name: Verification and evidence quality
baseline_requirement.question: Does each claim have the right evidence tier: unit/property/model, independent oracle, formal proof, blind holdout, external benchmark, or real study?

baseline_requirement.name: Ecosystem composition
baseline_requirement.question: Are pid-rs, NCP, Engram, Crebain, Galadriel, Haldir, SAFE, Rerun, ROS, and external tools integrated without hidden coupling or authority confusion?

baseline_requirement.name: Human factors and thesis defensibility
baseline_requirement.question: Can a reviewer understand the theory, assumptions, negative results, status, commands, evidence, and limits without being a Rust expert?

baseline_requirement.name: Counterfactual misuse and future maintenance
baseline_requirement.question: How could a rushed researcher, malicious source, overconfident paper, or future maintainer misuse a convenience path or reinterpret a result?

baseline_requirement.question: Are sampling units, dependence, multiplicity, calibration, confidence intervals, missingness, power, stopping, and sensitivity analyses correct?

baseline_requirement.name: PID and information theory
baseline_requirement.question: Are population, measure, estimator, and application gates separate; are atoms, units, preprocessing, support, and refusal semantics scientifically valid?

baseline_requirement.name: Type and state integrity
baseline_requirement.question: Can invalid study, split, episode, run-log, capture, intervention, model, or protocol states be represented or silently promoted?

baseline_requirement.name: Time, ordering, and replay
baseline_requirement.question: Are source time, receipt time, landmark time, treatment time, outcome time, censoring time, epoch, sequence, restart, and replay semantics unambiguous?

baseline_requirement.name: Identity and provenance
baseline_requirement.question: Can every result be traced to exact code, dependency, model, checkpoint, hook, tensor, dataset, split, transform, seed, configuration, and source artifact?

baseline_requirement.name: Data rights, privacy, and ethics
baseline_requirement.question: Are licenses, consent, personal data, human-subject issues, dataset rights, redaction, retention, and redistribution addressed before capture or release?

baseline_requirement.name: Security and hostile inputs
baseline_requirement.question: Can malformed JSON/NPZ/run logs, paths, bridges, NCP frames, model artifacts, or authenticated malicious peers corrupt state, escape confinement, or cause unsafe behavior?

baseline_requirement.question: Are bytes, rows, dimensions, events, episodes, artifacts, queues, requests, retries, logs, memory, CPU, disk, and session lifetime bounded before expensive work?

baseline_requirement.name: Determinism and reproducibility
baseline_requirement.question: Can a clean party reproduce builds, generated governance files, fixtures, randomization, simulations, metrics, reports, and package bytes?

baseline_requirement.name: API, schema, and SemVer

baseline_requirement.name: Baselines and falsification

baseline_requirement.name: Claims and scope
baseline_requirement.question: Could a reasonable reader infer a stronger scientific, engineering, security, or deployment claim than the retained evidence supports?

baseline_requirement.name: First-principles semantics
baseline_requirement.question: Are every estimand, event, intervention, diagnostic, outcome, state, transition, and refusal defined operationally rather than by suggestive names?

baseline_requirement.name: Causal identification
baseline_requirement.question: Are treatment assignment, pre-treatment timing, consistency, positivity, interference, confounding, censoring, and estimand identification assumptions explicit and defensible?

baseline_requirement.name: Statistics and uncertainty
baseline_requirement.question: Are sampling units, dependence, multiplicity, calibration, confidence intervals, missingness, power, stopping, and sensitivity analyses correct?

baseline_requirement.name: PID and information theory
baseline_requirement.question: Are population, measure, estimator, and application gates separate; are atoms, units, preprocessing, support, and refusal semantics scientifically valid?

baseline_requirement.name: Type and state integrity
baseline_requirement.question: Can invalid study, split, episode, run-log, capture, intervention, model, or protocol states be represented or silently promoted?

baseline_requirement.name: Time, ordering, and replay
baseline_requirement.question: Are source time, receipt time, landmark time, treatment time, outcome time, censoring time, epoch, sequence, restart, and replay semantics unambiguous?

baseline_requirement.name: Identity and provenance
baseline_requirement.question: Can every result be traced to exact code, dependency, model, checkpoint, hook, tensor, dataset, split, transform, seed, configuration, and source artifact?

baseline_requirement.name: Data rights, privacy, and ethics
baseline_requirement.question: Are licenses, consent, personal data, human-subject issues, dataset rights, redaction, retention, and redistribution addressed before capture or release?

baseline_requirement.name: Security and hostile inputs
baseline_requirement.question: Can malformed JSON/NPZ/run logs, paths, bridges, NCP frames, model artifacts, or authenticated malicious peers corrupt state, escape confinement, or cause unsafe behavior?

baseline_requirement.name: Resource bounds and denial of service
baseline_requirement.question: Are bytes, rows, dimensions, events, episodes, artifacts, queues, requests, retries, logs, memory, CPU, disk, and session lifetime bounded before expensive work?

baseline_requirement.name: Determinism and reproducibility

baseline_requirement.name: API, schema, and SemVer

baseline_requirement.name: Holdout and contamination control

baseline_requirement.name: Statistics and uncertainty
baseline_requirement.question: Are sampling units, dependence, multiplicity, calibration, confidence intervals, missingness, power, stopping, and sensitivity analyses correct?

baseline_requirement.name: PID and information theory
baseline_requirement.question: Are population, measure, estimator, and application gates separate; are atoms, units, preprocessing, support, and refusal semantics scientifically valid?

baseline_requirement.name: Type and state integrity
baseline_requirement.question: Can invalid study, split, episode, run-log, capture, intervention, model, or protocol states be represented or silently promoted?

baseline_requirement.name: Time, ordering, and replay
baseline_requirement.question: Are source time, receipt time, landmark time, treatment time, outcome time, censoring time, epoch, sequence, restart, and replay semantics unambiguous?

baseline_requirement.name: Identity and provenance
baseline_requirement.question: Can every result be traced to exact code, dependency, model, checkpoint, hook, tensor, dataset, split, transform, seed, configuration, and source artifact?

baseline_requirement.name: Data rights, privacy, and ethics
baseline_requirement.question: Are licenses, consent, personal data, human-subject issues, dataset rights, redaction, retention, and redistribution addressed before capture or release?

baseline_requirement.name: Security and hostile inputs
baseline_requirement.question: Can malformed JSON/NPZ/run logs, paths, bridges, NCP frames, model artifacts, or authenticated malicious peers corrupt state, escape confinement, or cause unsafe behavior?

baseline_requirement.name: Resource bounds and denial of service
baseline_requirement.question: Are bytes, rows, dimensions, events, episodes, artifacts, queues, requests, retries, logs, memory, CPU, disk, and session lifetime bounded before expensive work?

baseline_requirement.name: Concurrency, lifecycle, and crash consistency

baseline_requirement.name: Determinism and reproducibility

baseline_requirement.name: API, schema, and SemVer

baseline_requirement.name: Baselines and falsification

baseline_requirement.name: Claims and scope
baseline_requirement.question: Could a reasonable reader infer a stronger scientific, engineering, security, or deployment claim than the retained evidence supports?

baseline_requirement.name: First-principles semantics
baseline_requirement.question: Are every estimand, event, intervention, diagnostic, outcome, state, transition, and refusal defined operationally rather than by suggestive names?

baseline_requirement.name: Causal identification
baseline_requirement.question: Are treatment assignment, pre-treatment timing, consistency, positivity, interference, confounding, censoring, and estimand identification assumptions explicit and defensible?

baseline_requirement.name: Statistics and uncertainty
baseline_requirement.question: Are sampling units, dependence, multiplicity, calibration, confidence intervals, missingness, power, stopping, and sensitivity analyses correct?

baseline_requirement.name: PID and information theory
baseline_requirement.question: Are population, measure, estimator, and application gates separate; are atoms, units, preprocessing, support, and refusal semantics scientifically valid?

baseline_requirement.name: Type and state integrity
baseline_requirement.question: Can invalid study, split, episode, run-log, capture, intervention, model, or protocol states be represented or silently promoted?

baseline_requirement.name: Time, ordering, and replay
baseline_requirement.question: Are source time, receipt time, landmark time, treatment time, outcome time, censoring time, epoch, sequence, restart, and replay semantics unambiguous?

baseline_requirement.name: Identity and provenance
baseline_requirement.question: Can every result be traced to exact code, dependency, model, checkpoint, hook, tensor, dataset, split, transform, seed, configuration, and source artifact?

baseline_requirement.name: Data rights, privacy, and ethics
baseline_requirement.question: Are licenses, consent, personal data, human-subject issues, dataset rights, redaction, retention, and redistribution addressed before capture or release?

baseline_requirement.name: Security and hostile inputs
baseline_requirement.question: Can malformed JSON/NPZ/run logs, paths, bridges, NCP frames, model artifacts, or authenticated malicious peers corrupt state, escape confinement, or cause unsafe behavior?

baseline_requirement.name: Resource bounds and denial of service
baseline_requirement.question: Are bytes, rows, dimensions, events, episodes, artifacts, queues, requests, retries, logs, memory, CPU, disk, and session lifetime bounded before expensive work?

lenses.name: Resource bounds and denial of service

baseline_requirement.name: Concurrency, lifecycle, and crash consistency
baseline_requirement.question: Are append/ack ordering, partial writes, fsync scope, cancellation, shutdown, retries, restart, poisoned state, and cross-file transactions specified and tested?

baseline_requirement.name: Determinism and reproducibility
baseline_requirement.question: Can a clean party reproduce builds, generated governance files, fixtures, randomization, simulations, metrics, reports, and package bytes?

baseline_requirement.name: API, schema, and SemVer
baseline_requirement.question: Is the stable surface minimal and versioned; are unknown fields, migration, panic, allocation, feature, and compatibility rules explicit?

baseline_requirement.name: Baselines and falsification
baseline_requirement.question: Are strong non-PID comparators, negative controls, placebo checks, shuffled controls, odd/quirky cases, and simpler explanations tested fairly?

baseline_requirement.name: Holdout and contamination control
baseline_requirement.question: Are tuning and evaluation separated; is access auditable; are transforms fitted train-only; are task/model/family leakage and off-repo access considered?

baseline_requirement.name: Verification and evidence quality
baseline_requirement.question: Does each claim have the right evidence tier: unit/property/model, independent oracle, formal proof, blind holdout, external benchmark, or real study?

baseline_requirement.name: Ecosystem composition
baseline_requirement.question: Are pid-rs, NCP, Engram, Crebain, Galadriel, Haldir, SAFE, Rerun, ROS, and external tools integrated without hidden coupling or authority confusion?

baseline_requirement.name: Human factors and thesis defensibility
baseline_requirement.question: Can a reviewer understand the theory, assumptions, negative results, status, commands, evidence, and limits without being a Rust expert?

baseline_requirement.name: Counterfactual misuse and future maintenance
baseline_requirement.question: How could a rushed researcher, malicious source, overconfident paper, or future maintainer misuse a convenience path or reinterpret a result?

baseline_requirements.head_mismatch_rule: STOP before editing if HEAD, submodule identity, generated inputs, or relevant upstream release identity changed; produce a diff and re-open affected requirements.
mandatory_adversarial_questions: What invalid or misleading state can still be represented through JSON, Rust API, Python API, CLI, fixture, migration, or manual file edit?
What happens at empty, minimum, maximum, duplicate, stale, reordered, replayed, future-dated, censored, partially initialized, and shutdown boundaries?
Can a failed prerequisite, absent optional component, missing label, abstention, parse error, timeout, or exhausted capacity become a positive result?
Can tuning, visualization, derived artifacts, model selection, or off-repository access leak holdout information?
Can a green synthetic or in-process test pass while the real scientific, security, or deployment claim is false?
Could a reviewer reasonably confuse this output with evidence for H1, H2, H3, H4, EC1, causal use, safety, or PID validity?
baseline_requirements.phase_title: Harden SAFE and future real-VLA capture, tensor provenance, hooks, and data lineage
preconditions: Exact clean Prisoma commit and pid-rs submodule identity are recorded.
Every relevant tracked file and generated source is listed in the assignment.
Current behavior and public claim tier are documented before code changes.
Ambiguities and counterexamples are written before selecting semantics.
procedure: Read every in-scope file line by line and update FILE_REVIEW_LEDGER.csv with blob and SHA-256 identities.
Map each input, state, time, identity, output, failure, resource limit, assumption, and public statement.
Write normative SHALL/SHALL NOT requirements with stable identifiers.
Construct simple, odd, boundary, malformed, stale, replayed, missing, shifted, and adversarial counterexamples.
Implement the smallest coherent change; delete or quarantine contradictory fallback and historical paths.
Add unit, boundary, negative, property/metamorphic, fuzz, state-machine, statistical, and integration tests appropriate to the claim.
Generate evidence tied to exact code, tools, configuration, seeds, hardware, datasets, models, splits, and raw outputs.
Update schemas, migration, docs, claim registry, capability matrix, and exact dependency identities.
Run the local subsystem gate, complete wave gate, and every affected cross-repository conformance check.
Obtain independent review; record residual assumptions and claim impact.
required_evidence: complete commands, logs, and exit statuses
raw and summarized metrics with uncertainty where relevant
positive and negative fixtures or vectors
required_tests: property, metamorphic, or model-based case where applicable
full regression and documentation example gate

baseline_requirement.name: Claims and scope
baseline_requirement.question: Could a reasonable reader infer a stronger scientific, engineering, security, or deployment claim than the retained evidence supports?

baseline_requirement.name: First-principles semantics
baseline_requirement.question: Are every estimand, event, intervention, diagnostic, outcome, state, transition, and refusal defined operationally rather than by suggestive names?

baseline_requirement.name: Causal identification
baseline_requirement.question: Are treatment assignment, pre-treatment timing, consistency, positivity, interference, confounding, censoring, and estimand identification assumptions explicit and defensible?

baseline_requirement.name: Statistics and uncertainty
baseline_requirement.question: Are sampling units, dependence, multiplicity, calibration, confidence intervals, missingness, power, stopping, and sensitivity analyses correct?

baseline_requirement.name: PID and information theory
baseline_requirement.question: Are population, measure, estimator, and application gates separate; are atoms, units, preprocessing, support, and refusal semantics scientifically valid?

baseline_requirement.name: Type and state integrity
baseline_requirement.question: Can invalid study, split, episode, run-log, capture, intervention, model, or protocol states be represented or silently promoted?

baseline_requirement.name: Time, ordering, and replay
baseline_requirement.question: Are source time, receipt time, landmark time, treatment time, outcome time, censoring time, epoch, sequence, restart, and replay semantics unambiguous?

baseline_requirement.name: Identity and provenance
baseline_requirement.question: Can every result be traced to exact code, dependency, model, checkpoint, hook, tensor, dataset, split, transform, seed, configuration, and source artifact?

baseline_requirement.name: Data rights, privacy, and ethics
baseline_requirement.question: Are licenses, consent, personal data, human-subject issues, dataset rights, redaction, retention, and redistribution addressed before capture or release?

baseline_requirement.name: Security and hostile inputs
baseline_requirement.question: Can malformed JSON/NPZ/run logs, paths, bridges, NCP frames, model artifacts, or authenticated malicious peers corrupt state, escape confinement, or cause unsafe behavior?

baseline_requirement.name: Resource bounds and denial of service
baseline_requirement.question: Are bytes, rows, dimensions, events, episodes, artifacts, queues, requests, retries, logs, memory, CPU, disk, and session lifetime bounded before expensive work?

lenses.name: Resource bounds and denial of service

baseline_requirement.name: Concurrency, lifecycle, and crash consistency
baseline_requirement.question: Are append/ack ordering, partial writes, fsync scope, cancellation, shutdown, retries, restart, poisoned state, and cross-file transactions specified and tested?

baseline_requirement.name: Determinism and reproducibility
baseline_requirement.question: Can a clean party reproduce builds, generated governance files, fixtures, randomization, simulations, metrics, reports, and package bytes?

baseline_requirement.name: API, schema, and SemVer
baseline_requirement.question: Is the stable surface minimal and versioned; are unknown fields, migration, panic, allocation, feature, and compatibility rules explicit?

baseline_requirement.name: Baselines and falsification
baseline_requirement.question: Are strong non-PID comparators, negative controls, placebo checks, shuffled controls, odd/quirky cases, and simpler explanations tested fairly?

baseline_requirement.name: Holdout and contamination control
baseline_requirement.question: Are tuning and evaluation separated; is access auditable; are transforms fitted train-only; are task/model/family leakage and off-repo access considered?

baseline_requirement.name: Verification and evidence quality
baseline_requirement.question: Does each claim have the right evidence tier: unit/property/model, independent oracle, formal proof, blind holdout, external benchmark, or real study?

baseline_requirement.name: Ecosystem composition
baseline_requirement.question: Are pid-rs, NCP, Engram, Crebain, Galadriel, Haldir, SAFE, Rerun, ROS, and external tools integrated without hidden coupling or authority confusion?

baseline_requirement.name: Human factors and thesis defensibility
baseline_requirement.question: Can a reviewer understand the theory, assumptions, negative results, status, commands, evidence, and limits without being a Rust expert?

baseline_requirement.name: Counterfactual misuse and future maintenance
baseline_requirement.question: How could a rushed researcher, malicious source, overconfident paper, or future maintainer misuse a convenience path or reinterpret a result?

baseline_requirement.question: Could a reasonable reader infer a stronger scientific, engineering, security, or deployment claim than the retained evidence supports?

baseline_requirement.name: First-principles semantics
baseline_requirement.question: Are every estimand, event, intervention, diagnostic, outcome, state, transition, and refusal defined operationally rather than by suggestive names?

baseline_requirement.name: Causal identification
baseline_requirement.question: Are treatment assignment, pre-treatment timing, consistency, positivity, interference, confounding, censoring, and estimand identification assumptions explicit and defensible?

baseline_requirement.name: Statistics and uncertainty
baseline_requirement.question: Are sampling units, dependence, multiplicity, calibration, confidence intervals, missingness, power, stopping, and sensitivity analyses correct?

baseline_requirement.name: PID and information theory
baseline_requirement.question: Are population, measure, estimator, and application gates separate; are atoms, units, preprocessing, support, and refusal semantics scientifically valid?

baseline_requirement.name: Type and state integrity
baseline_requirement.question: Can invalid study, split, episode, run-log, capture, intervention, model, or protocol states be represented or silently promoted?

baseline_requirement.name: Time, ordering, and replay
baseline_requirement.question: Are source time, receipt time, landmark time, treatment time, outcome time, censoring time, epoch, sequence, restart, and replay semantics unambiguous?

baseline_requirement.name: Identity and provenance
baseline_requirement.question: Can every result be traced to exact code, dependency, model, checkpoint, hook, tensor, dataset, split, transform, seed, configuration, and source artifact?

baseline_requirement.name: Data rights, privacy, and ethics
baseline_requirement.question: Are licenses, consent, personal data, human-subject issues, dataset rights, redaction, retention, and redistribution addressed before capture or release?

baseline_requirement.name: Security and hostile inputs
baseline_requirement.question: Can malformed JSON/NPZ/run logs, paths, bridges, NCP frames, model artifacts, or authenticated malicious peers corrupt state, escape confinement, or cause unsafe behavior?

baseline_requirement.name: Resource bounds and denial of service
baseline_requirement.question: Are bytes, rows, dimensions, events, episodes, artifacts, queues, requests, retries, logs, memory, CPU, disk, and session lifetime bounded before expensive work?

lenses.name: Resource bounds and denial of service

baseline_requirement.name: Concurrency, lifecycle, and crash consistency
baseline_requirement.question: Are append/ack ordering, partial writes, fsync scope, cancellation, shutdown, retries, restart, poisoned state, and cross-file transactions specified and tested?

baseline_requirement.name: Determinism and reproducibility
baseline_requirement.question: Can a clean party reproduce builds, generated governance files, fixtures, randomization, simulations, metrics, reports, and package bytes?

baseline_requirement.name: API, schema, and SemVer
baseline_requirement.question: Is the stable surface minimal and versioned; are unknown fields, migration, panic, allocation, feature, and compatibility rules explicit?

baseline_requirement.name: Baselines and falsification
baseline_requirement.question: Are strong non-PID comparators, negative controls, placebo checks, shuffled controls, odd/quirky cases, and simpler explanations tested fairly?

baseline_requirement.name: Holdout and contamination control
baseline_requirement.question: Are tuning and evaluation separated; is access auditable; are transforms fitted train-only; are task/model/family leakage and off-repo access considered?

baseline_requirement.name: Verification and evidence quality
baseline_requirement.question: Does each claim have the right evidence tier: unit/property/model, independent oracle, formal proof, blind holdout, external benchmark, or real study?

baseline_requirement.name: Ecosystem composition
baseline_requirement.question: Are pid-rs, NCP, Engram, Crebain, Galadriel, Haldir, SAFE, Rerun, ROS, and external tools integrated without hidden coupling or authority confusion?

baseline_requirement.name: Human factors and thesis defensibility
baseline_requirement.question: Can a reviewer understand the theory, assumptions, negative results, status, commands, evidence, and limits without being a Rust expert?

baseline_requirement.name: Counterfactual misuse and future maintenance
baseline_requirement.question: How could a rushed researcher, malicious source, overconfident paper, or future maintainer misuse a convenience path or reinterpret a result?

baseline_requirements.completion_rule: Do not close on compilation, a single test, or prose. Close only when the normative requirement, all applicable evidence tiers, twenty-lens review, migration, docs, and independent review pass. Otherwise remove/narrow the claim or leave the task OPEN.
baseline_requirements.head_mismatch_rule: STOP before editing if HEAD, submodule identity, generated inputs, or relevant upstream release identity changed; produce a diff and re-open affected requirements.
mandatory_adversarial_questions: What invalid or misleading state can still be represented through JSON, Rust API, Python API, CLI, fixture, migration, or manual file edit?
What happens at empty, minimum, maximum, duplicate, stale, reordered, replayed, future-dated, censored, partially initialized, and shutdown boundaries?
Can a failed prerequisite, absent optional component, missing label, abstention, parse error, timeout, or exhausted capacity become a positive result?
Can tuning, visualization, derived artifacts, model selection, or off-repository access leak holdout information?
Can a green synthetic or in-process test pass while the real scientific, security, or deployment claim is false?
Could a reviewer reasonably confuse this output with evidence for H1, H2, H3, H4, EC1, causal use, safety, or PID validity?
baseline_requirements.phase_title: Migrate NCP/Engram observation and preserve optional ecosystem composition
preconditions: Exact clean Prisoma commit and pid-rs submodule identity are recorded.
Every relevant tracked file and generated source is listed in the assignment.
Current behavior and public claim tier are documented before code changes.
Ambiguities and counterexamples are written before selecting semantics.
procedure: Read every in-scope file line by line and update FILE_REVIEW_LEDGER.csv with blob and SHA-256 identities.
Map each input, state, time, identity, output, failure, resource limit, assumption, and public statement.
Write normative SHALL/SHALL NOT requirements with stable identifiers.
Construct simple, odd, boundary, malformed, stale, replayed, missing, shifted, and adversarial counterexamples.
Implement the smallest coherent change; delete or quarantine contradictory fallback and historical paths.
Add unit, boundary, negative, property/metamorphic, fuzz, state-machine, statistical, and integration tests appropriate to the claim.
Generate evidence tied to exact code, tools, configuration, seeds, hardware, datasets, models, splits, and raw outputs.
Update schemas, migration, docs, claim registry, capability matrix, and exact dependency identities.
Run the local subsystem gate, complete wave gate, and every affected cross-repository conformance check.
Obtain independent review; record residual assumptions and claim impact.

raw and summarized metrics with uncertainty where relevant
positive and negative fixtures or vectors
required_tests: property, metamorphic, or model-based case where applicable
full regression and documentation example gate

baseline_requirement.name: Claims and scope

baseline_requirement.name: First-principles semantics
baseline_requirement.question: Are every estimand, event, intervention, diagnostic, outcome, state, transition, and refusal defined operationally rather than by suggestive names?

baseline_requirement.name: Causal identification
baseline_requirement.question: Are treatment assignment, pre-treatment timing, consistency, positivity, interference, confounding, censoring, and estimand identification assumptions explicit and defensible?

baseline_requirement.name: Statistics and uncertainty
baseline_requirement.question: Are sampling units, dependence, multiplicity, calibration, confidence intervals, missingness, power, stopping, and sensitivity analyses correct?

baseline_requirement.name: PID and information theory
baseline_requirement.question: Are population, measure, estimator, and application gates separate; are atoms, units, preprocessing, support, and refusal semantics scientifically valid?

baseline_requirement.name: Type and state integrity
baseline_requirement.question: Can invalid study, split, episode, run-log, capture, intervention, model, or protocol states be represented or silently promoted?

baseline_requirement.name: Time, ordering, and replay
baseline_requirement.question: Are source time, receipt time, landmark time, treatment time, outcome time, censoring time, epoch, sequence, restart, and replay semantics unambiguous?

baseline_requirement.name: Identity and provenance
baseline_requirement.question: Can every result be traced to exact code, dependency, model, checkpoint, hook, tensor, dataset, split, transform, seed, configuration, and source artifact?

baseline_requirement.name: Data rights, privacy, and ethics
baseline_requirement.question: Are licenses, consent, personal data, human-subject issues, dataset rights, redaction, retention, and redistribution addressed before capture or release?

baseline_requirement.name: Security and hostile inputs
baseline_requirement.question: Can malformed JSON/NPZ/run logs, paths, bridges, NCP frames, model artifacts, or authenticated malicious peers corrupt state, escape confinement, or cause unsafe behavior?

baseline_requirement.name: Resource bounds and denial of service
baseline_requirement.question: Are bytes, rows, dimensions, events, episodes, artifacts, queues, requests, retries, logs, memory, CPU, disk, and session lifetime bounded before expensive work?

baseline_requirement.name: Concurrency, lifecycle, and crash consistency

baseline_requirement.name: Determinism and reproducibility
baseline_requirement.question: Can a clean party reproduce builds, generated governance files, fixtures, randomization, simulations, metrics, reports, and package bytes?

baseline_requirement.name: API, schema, and SemVer
baseline_requirement.question: Is the stable surface minimal and versioned; are unknown fields, migration, panic, allocation, feature, and compatibility rules explicit?

baseline_requirement.name: Baselines and falsification
baseline_requirement.question: Are strong non-PID comparators, negative controls, placebo checks, shuffled controls, odd/quirky cases, and simpler explanations tested fairly?

baseline_requirement.name: Verification and evidence quality
baseline_requirement.question: Does each claim have the right evidence tier: unit/property/model, independent oracle, formal proof, blind holdout, external benchmark, or real study?

baseline_requirement.name: Ecosystem composition
baseline_requirement.question: Are pid-rs, NCP, Engram, Crebain, Galadriel, Haldir, SAFE, Rerun, ROS, and external tools integrated without hidden coupling or authority confusion?

baseline_requirement.name: Human factors and thesis defensibility
baseline_requirement.question: Can a reviewer understand the theory, assumptions, negative results, status, commands, evidence, and limits without being a Rust expert?

baseline_requirement.question: How could a rushed researcher, malicious source, overconfident paper, or future maintainer misuse a convenience path or reinterpret a result?

baseline_requirements.head_mismatch_rule: STOP before editing if HEAD, submodule identity, generated inputs, or relevant upstream release identity changed; produce a diff and re-open affected requirements.
mandatory_adversarial_questions: What invalid or misleading state can still be represented through JSON, Rust API, Python API, CLI, fixture, migration, or manual file edit?
What happens at empty, minimum, maximum, duplicate, stale, reordered, replayed, future-dated, censored, partially initialized, and shutdown boundaries?
Can a failed prerequisite, absent optional component, missing label, abstention, parse error, timeout, or exhausted capacity become a positive result?
Can tuning, visualization, derived artifacts, model selection, or off-repository access leak holdout information?
Can a green synthetic or in-process test pass while the real scientific, security, or deployment claim is false?
Could a reviewer reasonably confuse this output with evidence for H1, H2, H3, H4, EC1, causal use, safety, or PID validity?
baseline_requirements.phase_title: Independent verification, thesis-board evidence, local convergence, and final release
preconditions: Exact clean Prisoma commit and pid-rs submodule identity are recorded.
Every relevant tracked file and generated source is listed in the assignment.
Current behavior and public claim tier are documented before code changes.
Ambiguities and counterexamples are written before selecting semantics.
procedure: Read every in-scope file line by line and update FILE_REVIEW_LEDGER.csv with blob and SHA-256 identities.
Map each input, state, time, identity, output, failure, resource limit, assumption, and public statement.
Write normative SHALL/SHALL NOT requirements with stable identifiers.
Construct simple, odd, boundary, malformed, stale, replayed, missing, shifted, and adversarial counterexamples.
Implement the smallest coherent change; delete or quarantine contradictory fallback and historical paths.
Add unit, boundary, negative, property/metamorphic, fuzz, state-machine, statistical, and integration tests appropriate to the claim.
Generate evidence tied to exact code, tools, configuration, seeds, hardware, datasets, models, splits, and raw outputs.
Update schemas, migration, docs, claim registry, capability matrix, and exact dependency identities.
Run the local subsystem gate, complete wave gate, and every affected cross-repository conformance check.
Obtain independent review; record residual assumptions and claim impact.
required_evidence: complete commands, logs, and exit statuses
raw and summarized metrics with uncertainty where relevant
positive and negative fixtures or vectors
required_tests: property, metamorphic, or model-based case where applicable
full regression and documentation example gate
baseline_requirements.title: Create a non-Rust reviewer packet with equations, schemas, traces, and executable notebooks/reports.

baseline_requirement.name: Claims and scope
baseline_requirement.question: Could a reasonable reader infer a stronger scientific, engineering, security, or deployment claim than the retained evidence supports?

baseline_requirement.name: First-principles semantics
baseline_requirement.question: Are every estimand, event, intervention, diagnostic, outcome, state, transition, and refusal defined operationally rather than by suggestive names?

baseline_requirement.name: Causal identification
baseline_requirement.question: Are treatment assignment, pre-treatment timing, consistency, positivity, interference, confounding, censoring, and estimand identification assumptions explicit and defensible?

baseline_requirement.name: Statistics and uncertainty
baseline_requirement.question: Are sampling units, dependence, multiplicity, calibration, confidence intervals, missingness, power, stopping, and sensitivity analyses correct?

baseline_requirement.name: PID and information theory
baseline_requirement.question: Are population, measure, estimator, and application gates separate; are atoms, units, preprocessing, support, and refusal semantics scientifically valid?

baseline_requirement.name: Type and state integrity
baseline_requirement.question: Can invalid study, split, episode, run-log, capture, intervention, model, or protocol states be represented or silently promoted?

baseline_requirement.name: Time, ordering, and replay
baseline_requirement.question: Are source time, receipt time, landmark time, treatment time, outcome time, censoring time, epoch, sequence, restart, and replay semantics unambiguous?

baseline_requirement.name: Identity and provenance
baseline_requirement.question: Can every result be traced to exact code, dependency, model, checkpoint, hook, tensor, dataset, split, transform, seed, configuration, and source artifact?

baseline_requirement.name: Data rights, privacy, and ethics
baseline_requirement.question: Are licenses, consent, personal data, human-subject issues, dataset rights, redaction, retention, and redistribution addressed before capture or release?

baseline_requirement.name: Security and hostile inputs
baseline_requirement.question: Can malformed JSON/NPZ/run logs, paths, bridges, NCP frames, model artifacts, or authenticated malicious peers corrupt state, escape confinement, or cause unsafe behavior?

baseline_requirement.name: Resource bounds and denial of service
baseline_requirement.question: Are bytes, rows, dimensions, events, episodes, artifacts, queues, requests, retries, logs, memory, CPU, disk, and session lifetime bounded before expensive work?

lenses.name: Resource bounds and denial of service

baseline_requirement.name: Concurrency, lifecycle, and crash consistency
baseline_requirement.question: Are append/ack ordering, partial writes, fsync scope, cancellation, shutdown, retries, restart, poisoned state, and cross-file transactions specified and tested?

baseline_requirement.name: Determinism and reproducibility
baseline_requirement.question: Can a clean party reproduce builds, generated governance files, fixtures, randomization, simulations, metrics, reports, and package bytes?

baseline_requirement.name: API, schema, and SemVer
baseline_requirement.question: Is the stable surface minimal and versioned; are unknown fields, migration, panic, allocation, feature, and compatibility rules explicit?

baseline_requirement.name: Baselines and falsification
baseline_requirement.question: Are strong non-PID comparators, negative controls, placebo checks, shuffled controls, odd/quirky cases, and simpler explanations tested fairly?

baseline_requirement.name: Holdout and contamination control
baseline_requirement.question: Are tuning and evaluation separated; is access auditable; are transforms fitted train-only; are task/model/family leakage and off-repo access considered?

baseline_requirement.name: Verification and evidence quality
baseline_requirement.question: Does each claim have the right evidence tier: unit/property/model, independent oracle, formal proof, blind holdout, external benchmark, or real study?

baseline_requirement.name: Ecosystem composition
baseline_requirement.question: Are pid-rs, NCP, Engram, Crebain, Galadriel, Haldir, SAFE, Rerun, ROS, and external tools integrated without hidden coupling or authority confusion?

baseline_requirement.name: Human factors and thesis defensibility
baseline_requirement.question: Can a reviewer understand the theory, assumptions, negative results, status, commands, evidence, and limits without being a Rust expert?

baseline_requirement.name: Counterfactual misuse and future maintenance
baseline_requirement.question: How could a rushed researcher, malicious source, overconfident paper, or future maintainer misuse a convenience path or reinterpret a result?
